title: Node 2 - Journal Signal Extractor output
description: source_quote must be a literal substring of a USER turn. Enforced in code at Step 5, not by this schema. no_symptom_statements exists because an absence of observations and an affirmative report of no difficulty are different facts, and an empty observations list cannot tell them apart.

no_symptom_statements.description: User turns that affirmatively report noticing no difficulty. Positive evidence, not the absence of evidence.
